colorScheme.note: Only :root tokens change in dark mode; each colorMeta entry carries its dark value in darkMode. --gradient-accent keeps its deep stops in both modes; --gradient-text brightens in dark.

gradients.name: gradient-accent

gradients.name: gradient-text
gradients.purpose: Eyebrows, process numerals, one highlighted phrase per section.

gradients.name: gradient-glow
gradients.purpose: Decorative blooms at hero/pricing corners only, hidden below lg.

body.purpose: Running text in Outfit; article text capped at 33em.

shadows.name: shadow-glow

components.name: Glass Button
components.css: .ds-btn-glass{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:48px;padding:0 32px;border-radius:8px;background:hsl(0 0% 100%);border:1px solid hsl(248 22% 88%);color:hsl(248 28% 12%);font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 1px 2px hsl(250 40% 20% / .05),0 10px 30px -14px hsl(250 40% 20% / .12);transition:all .3s;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-glass:hover{background:hsl(248 38% 94%);transform:scale(1.05)}.ds-btn-glass:active{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-btn-glass:focus-visible{outline:2px solid hsl(248 56% 40%);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Cream-at-85% blurred floating chrome (nav, phone booking bar).
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:22px;background:hsl(40 33% 98% / .85);border:1px solid hsl(248 22% 88% / .8);box-shadow:0 1px 2px hsl(250 40% 20% / .05),0 10px 30px -14px hsl(250 40% 20% / .12);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(160%);font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif}.ds-nav-brand{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-weight:700;color:hsl(248 28% 12%);margin-right:auto}.ds-nav a{color:hsl(248 14% 36%);text-decoration:none;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;transition:color .3s}.ds-nav a:hover{color:hsl(248 56% 36%)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid hsl(248 56% 40%);outline-offset:2px}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){.ds-nav{background:hsl(248 30% 9% / .82);border-color:hsl(248 18% 26% / .8)}.ds-nav-brand{color:hsl(240 30% 94%)}.ds-nav a{color:hsl(240 16% 74%)}}

components.name: Featured Pricing Card
components.description: The one featured package: 1.5px violet-to-cyan border via two background layers.

narrative.overview:
A warm off-white page, near-black indigo ink, and one luminous violet-to-cyan gradient that marks what matters: CTAs, eyebrows, process numerals, the featured-card border, one highlighted phrase. Content sits on white cards with soft, cool shadows; sections alternate between the cream canvas and a faint indigo tint, and the footer closes the page as the one deep-indigo surface.

The mood is bright, precise and trustworthy. Credibility comes from legibility: clear prices, clear packages, real reviews, named recent work, with Roman visible in the hero note, founder panel, contact panel and booking dialog.

Dark mode follows the system preference and swaps only tokens: indigo-black canvas, darker cards, a light indigo primary, and a brightened text gradient; the CTA gradient keeps its deep stops.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas, near-black indigo text
Deep indigo as the working accent
Violet-blue-cyan gradient reserved for CTAs, gradient text, the featured border and blooms
White cards with 24-28px corners, one soft resting shadow, gentle hover lift
Alternating section tints instead of hairline dividers
System-preference dark mode via token overrides only

rules.name: The Gradient Rule
rules.body: The violet-to-cyan gradient appears only on CTA fills, gradient text (eyebrows, numerals, one phrase), the featured pricing border and decorative blooms. Never on paragraphs or behind body text.

rules.name: Indigo Is the Working Accent
rules.body: Icons, links, check marks, prices, focus rings and package-button text use indigo-ink.

rules.name: The One Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: The footer is the one deep-indigo surface; focus rings there switch to footer-text.

rules.name: The Visible Edge Rule
rules.body: Form fields keep a >= 3:1 edge (input-edge) against cards, canvas and tint; focus draws a solid primary edge.

rules.name: The AA Floor
rules.body: text-ink about 15:1 and text-slate about 7:1 on cream; gradient text stops >= 4.5:1 on the canvas.

rules.name: Calm at Rest
rules.body: Nothing glows at rest; shadows deepen only on hover or focus.

dos: Do reserve the gradient for CTAs, gradient text, the featured border and corner blooms
Do alternate section bands with the indigo tint
Do keep chip colors in --chip-bg/--chip-border tokens so dark values win the cascade
donts: Don't put the gradient under or behind paragraphs, or set body copy in gradient text
Don't add a second accent hue
Don't use pure black; text is text-ink, borders are hairline
Don't make anything glow at rest
Don't hide server-rendered content with framer-motion initial opacity 0
Don't report booking outcomes in toasts
